decisions.text: type bar: the periods are the point
clustered bars: 2 series of one measure across periods (G1.56, R9-12)
2 series side by side in each cluster, the bars touching, in the same order in every cluster: Expenses (slot 1), Budget (slot 2) (G7.5, G4.22)
time runs left to right: vertical bars
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$120K (expenses per month)”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the unit phrase on the top label: “$120K (expenses per month)”; the top gridline starts after it
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: Expenses, Budget (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)

source.shows: the book's “just bars” version: clustered bars over the months, with a legend; the budget weighs as much as the expenses
